scope: training for healthy voices; not diagnosis or treatment

evidenceTiers.A: systematic review, research synthesis or robust institutional guidance
evidenceTiers.B: peer-reviewed empirical evidence or precisely documented protocol
evidenceTiers.C: structured professional voice and speech pedagogy
evidenceTiers.H: VoiceAct product hypothesis requiring validation before high scoring weight
evidenceTiers.R: restricted to qualified or certified clinical supervision
